about.title: About
about.subtitle: Learn about OffStrap
about.systemOverviewP1: OffStrap Connect is the official companion app for the OffStrap line of smart travel gear. It establishes a secure Bluetooth and LTE link to OffStrap-certified luggage, giving you reliable control, real-time monitoring, and advanced protection for your belongings.
about.systemOverviewP2: The app is designed exclusively for authorized OffStrap hardware. Attempts to connect with unsupported devices, reverse engineer software, or tamper with firmware or hardware are prohibited and will void warranty and service eligibility.
about.featSmartUnlockingBody:
• Unlock from the app
• Fingerprint access via the bag's integrated sensor
about.featLocationBody:
• Live GPS tracking via onboard SIM module
• Bluetooth proximity alerts
• Lost Mode with higher-frequency pings
• Quick “Track” action to retrieve immediate location
about.featTravelModeBody:
• Optimizes connectivity and power usage while in transit
• Temporarily disables all radio-emitting modules, such as the cellular network, for safe use during flights.
about.featSecurityBody:
• App access control via biometrics or passcode
• Auto-lock after inactivity
• Notifications for tamper events, low battery, and unusual activity
about.featNotificationsBody:
• Enable/disable categories of alerts
• Set custom alert thresholds for battery level, tamper attempts, and bluetooth proximity.
about.supportP1: Need help setting up your bag, reporting a bug, or troubleshooting connectivity? Our team is here to help.
about.disclaimerP1: OffStrap Connect is designed to enhance the security and usability of your luggage. While the app provides monitoring and deterrence features, no system can guarantee prevention of theft, unauthorized access, or data loss.
about.disclaimerP2: Smart Strap Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is not liable for loss, damage, or theft of bags or personal property. Misuse of the hardware or software, including tampering, force unlocking, or unauthorized firmware modification will void warranty coverage and service commitments.
about.disclaimerP3: The app may use GPS and Bluetooth in the background. Force Closing the app can cause the OffStrap to assume a worst case scenario, and will hence impact OffStrap's battery life. We only collect the minimum data required for pairing and essential diagnostics. For details, please see our Privacy Policy.
about.licenseBody: All application content, including UI, icons, firmware protocols, and connectivity architecture is the intellectual property of Smart Strap Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Unauthorized copying, distribution, or reverse engineering is prohibited.
about.updatesBody: We ship regular updates to improve performance and add features. For the best experience, keep both your app and bag firmware up to date.
